gen_risks.description: Potential exposure or misuse of personal biographic and biometric data during the scale-up of digital identification and targeting registries.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce privacy-by-design architecture, comply with personal data protection Law 09-08, and deliver mandatory data protection training for platform operators.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to... data protection issues

gen_risks.description: Risk of financial duplication or expenditure overlap due to using the shared AMO-TADAMON budget line across multiple World Bank-financed programs.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish dedicated budget codes within the Ministry of Interior budget for PBC-related activities and deploy custom financial tracking software.
gen_risks.evidence: the risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line 'AMO-TADAMON' to justify expenditure

gen_risks.description: Delays in the operationalization and staffing of the National Registry Agency due to Ministry of Interior capacity strain during rapid registry rollout.
gen_risks.mitigation: Execute a structured operationalization roadmap backed by PBC targets for appointing key staff and approving operational manuals.
gen_risks.evidence: This rapid expansion has strained the government’s and the MoI’s capacity to take steps in operationalizing the NRA.

gen_risks.description: Risk of excluding vulnerable populations, such as illiterate individuals, disabled persons, and remote residents, due to outreach gaps or complex registration.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement inclusive engagement strategies under the Stakeholder Engagement Plan, utilize 1,600 Citizen Service Centers, and deploy satellite-equipped mobile units.
gen_risks.evidence: exclusion of some vulnerable groups due to inefficient or inadequate public communication and outreach efforts

gen_risks.description: Reluctance of informal sector workers to register in the NPR and SR due to fears of becoming susceptible to taxation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Launch targeted communication campaigns emphasizing data confidentiality, strict separation from tax databases, and social protection benefits.
gen_risks.evidence: workers in the informal sector, are wary of providing their information to the government due to perceived risks of making them susceptible to taxation.

gen_risks.description: Seasonal and annual income fluctuations among farmers and informal workers impairing their ability to maintain health insurance payments.
gen_risks.mitigation: Refine SR proxy-means testing formulas and dynamic recertification protocols to adjust welfare scoring during income shocks.
gen_risks.evidence: Several categories of non-salaried workers, in particular farmers... suffer from two patterns of irregularities in the flow of income

gen_risks.description: Data quality and timeliness challenges in financial reporting resulting from reliance on manual Excel spreadsheets and budget software extractions.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop, install, and operationalize dedicated financial management software to automate IFR preparation and annual financial statements.
gen_risks.evidence: the use of a spreadsheet 'Excel' and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to some challenges

gen_risks.description: Environmental risks and hazardous waste accumulation resulting from improper disposal of electronic devices and mobile registration hardware.
gen_risks.mitigation: Adhere to sustainable IT procurement standards and enforce asset management e-waste disposal procedures across participating Ministries.
gen_risks.evidence: Risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e-waste and its improper disposal.

gen_risks.description: Severe climate shocks and recurrent droughts causing widespread agricultural job losses and worsening rural household poverty.
gen_risks.mitigation: Leverage NPR location data and SR welfare scores to rapidly deploy adaptive social transfers to climate-affected populations.
gen_risks.evidence: Rainfall shocks are estimated to account for almost 37 percent of the recent volatility of GDP growth in Morocco

gen_risks.description: Infrastructure and connectivity deficits at isolated Civil Registry Offices hindering automated digital birth and death data exchange with the NPR.
gen_risks.mitigation: Upgrade Civil Registry Office IT hardware, software, and electronic data exchange infrastructure nationwide under Component 1.
gen_risks.evidence: some of which are in very isolated areas and require substantial investments in overall infrastructure, beyond the needs of new hardware

gen_risks.description: Legal and regulatory delays in finalizing inter-institutional governance agreements required to transfer registry oversight from MoI to NRA.
gen_risks.mitigation: Utilize Inter-ministerial Steering Committee oversight to finalize legal decrees, data-sharing protocols, and operational transfer manuals.
gen_risks.evidence: requires the elaboration and extension of the legal framework, and the establishment of governance agreements with programs

gen_risks.description: Service disruptions or operational delays during contract maintenance tranches for core biometric and software infrastructure systems.
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate clear contract management procedures into the POM and execute Project Procurement Strategy for Development (PPSD) maintenance guidelines.
gen_risks.evidence: PPSD should provide the practical modalities and measures to manage the optional tranches relating to the maintenance of the contracts

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risk is assessed as Substantial. Given the complex nature of the operation and the involvement of multiple stakeholders in the implementation of the National Population Register (NPR) and the Social Registry (SR), the Project Management Unit (PMU) will need to put considerable effort into ensuring better coordination to achieve the PDO. The national rollout and the improvement of the NPR and the SR will need strong stakeholder engagement, including citizens concerned by social protection programs who are often poor and vulnerable.
gt_risks.mitigation: The communication strategy will continue to inform all stakeholders involved in project implementation and will capitalize on lessons learned from the first Identity and Targeting for Social Protection project (P155198). The PMU envisions improving the grievance mechanism at local and national levels and establishing a system to promote citizen engagement and transparency. The Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee is responsible for developing guidelines for the strategic policy for the envisaged reform and ensuring a link with the ongoing social protection reform. Technical work will also cover a process evaluation to identify challenges, propose remedies, and provide recommendations to enhance system implementation at central and local levels.
